name: Mangrove Swamp
desc: A living mangrove swamp at slack tide — four ranks of trees stand on tangles of arching prop roots that splay down into still tidal water, dense foliage crowding the canopy, the water holding a green upside-down forest that keeps sliding and breaking into bands as ripple rings open where something moves below, mist scrolling between the ranks and dappled light coming through; teal tidal green, tannin blackwater at dusk, a moonlit nocturne, an x-ray of the root network, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: how hard the light and water work — dappled light, glints, reflection contrast

scale.doc: how large the trees and root tangles are — canopy height, root spread (rebuilds the swamp)

density.doc: how many trees per rank, prop roots, leaves, ripples and glints

speed.doc: mist scroll, reflection ripple and canopy sway rate

tide.doc: water level and how strongly the reflection holds — high tide gives a fuller mirror

haze.doc: how thick the swamp haze is — how far back the ranks fade

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default mangrove green

x.doc: which way the light comes from — lit side of trunks, roots and foliage

y.doc: the waterline — low y gives more water and more reflection

style.doc: aesthetic: tidal = living green mangrove, teal water, warm dappled light; blackwater = tannin-stained dark water at dusk, deep greens; nocturne = moonlit blue-silver; xray = root network as white botanical lines on dark, no colour; ink = sumi silhouette roots and canopy in tonal wash

act.doc: multi-minute programme — slack calm high water with a still mirror, an ebbing tide with more ripple, or a breeze stirring the canopy and water

seed.doc: regenerates the trees, prop roots, foliage and mist

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
